statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I25.10 was used
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
